correctness.rationale: For each fixed N, all eight length-three subsequence counts are recovered exactly from 011,101,001. Equality of the first two forces gap displacement (t,-3t,3t,-t); equality of 001 forces t(c-b+3t)=0. Every nonzero solution is uniquely t=(b-c)/3, and nonnegativity yields the stated oriented two-word parametrization without duplicate fibers. The independent geometric series z^4/((1-z)^2(1-z^2)(1-z^4)) counts precisely one parameter tuple per doubleton fiber; subtracting from C(n,3) proves the rational identity at all n. The pair-count singularity gives the constant 1/48 and asymptotic ambiguity fraction 1/4. Complete eight-coordinate exact deck enumeration of 23751 zero-gap vectors at N=0..25, direct position-combinations cross-checks and 500 larger deterministic tests passed. The finite checks alone are not used as proof.

originality.rationale: The 2021 primary article explicitly states the precise generating function as Conjecture 1 after a finite twenty-coefficient experiment (Section 5.3, p.17). Its existing 2-deck nullspace and lower-bound argument are acknowledged, not rebranded as new. The proof here supplies a full if-and-only-if classification of 3-deck collisions and counts every class for arbitrary length. A newer all-weight result proves only the growth exponent of unrestricted binary three-deck counts, and work on binomial complexity of infinite words selects a different domain. Exact published-finding corpus meaning searches, publication web searches, accessible prior-claim comparisons, and material inspection of plausible primary sources identified no stronger covering statement. Unindexed equivalent proof remains an explicitly acknowledged residual risk.
residual_risks: A proof of the same identity could be in unindexed, very recent, or otherwise unobserved literature; independent novelty verification has not been performed.
Comparisons to some related works were limited to their mathematically relevant definitions, sections and theorems, rather than a line-by-line audit of every ancillary remark.

value.rationale: The result proves the exact all-length formula explicitly conjectured by the directly relevant primary article, extends its preceding cubic-order estimate, and fully describes every ambiguity fiber. Exact fiber multiplicities inform zero-error sequence reconstruction in the fixed-weight binary three-deck channel. The one-quarter asymptotic ambiguous-word law is an intrinsic nontrivial consequence rather than a numerical finite-table extension. No extrapolation, arbitrary unmotivated fixed case, or unsupported downstream theorem is needed.
